description.value: Motto by Hilton New York City Times Square is a Hilton lifestyle hotel in Midtown. Hilton says Motto will entice guests looking for connection and efficiency. Its guest rooms are designed with an intentional footprint, so expect compact rooms and a central location near Broadway. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Affordable and clean, you get what you pay for in New York”; “The front desk staff were also very nice”. Representative watch-outs: “Rooms are super small”.
